$comment: Provenance manifest for every third-party asset used by the prototype. fetch-sources.mjs downloads these into .cache/sources; build-assets.mjs turns them into public/assets. 'rightsReview' records what has and has not been verified; uploader-asserted licences are not treated as a rights warranty (see docs/research/scientific-data-and-licensing.md).

objaverse.$comment: Objaverse 1.0 (allenai/objaverse on Hugging Face) mirrors Sketchfab uploads together with the uploader's licence and attribution metadata.

items.title: Tyrannosaurus Rex Lowpoly
items.creator: pikabobalex
items.modifications: Rescaled to ~12 m length, re-oriented, walk loop trimmed from the source showcase animation (frames 0-28), idle and roar clips authored in Blender, textures resized and compressed.
items.rightsReview: Uploader-asserted CC BY 4.0. Description states it was sculpted in ZBrush, retopologised in 3D-Coat and rigged in 3ds Max by the uploader. No duplicate uploads of the mesh found in Objaverse. Not independently verified.

items.title: Triceratops
items.creator: Erina eka syaharani (erinaekasyaharani)
items.modifications: Rescaled to ~8.5 m length, re-oriented, source walk cycle kept, graze and alert clips authored in Blender, textures resized and compressed.
items.rightsReview: Uploader-asserted CC BY 4.0. Earliest Objaverse upload of this mesh (2020-01-05); a later 'Torosaurus' remix by another user shares the mesh. Not independently verified.

items.title: Tyrannosaurus Rex / Triceratops [SmithsonianDPO]
items.creator: Smithsonian Digitization Program Office (repost by Thomas Flynn)
items.modifications: Decimated, textures resized and compressed, rescaled and placed on a plinth.
items.rightsReview: Smithsonian Open Access data reposted under CC0. Per the Smithsonian description, the T. rex is a single fossil individual (unearthed in Montana from 1988) and the Triceratops is a digital composite scaled from several specimens. The original Smithsonian record could not be fetched during research (HTTP 403).

items.title: Bald Cypress
items.creator: BaptisteBerard
items.modifications: Rescaled, textures resized and compressed, instanced as stand-in for Hell Creek taxodiaceous conifers.
items.rightsReview: Uploader-asserted CC BY 4.0. Description says it was made with SpeedTree; rights in any bundled SpeedTree library textures not verified.

items.title: Fern
items.creator: evolveduk
items.modifications: Rescaled, textures resized and compressed, instanced as ground cover.
items.rightsReview: Uploader-asserted CC BY 4.0 ('fern made in treeit'). Not independently verified.
